children: Hungary's central bank kept its base interest rate at 5.5% (HUINT=ECI) on Tuesday as widely expected, amid upside inflation risks from global energy prices and the government's plans for large wage rises and tax cuts in next year's budget.
The decision was in line with the unanimous forecast of 13 economists in a Reuters poll last week.
